description: uesgraphs, published by RWTH-EBC, stores urban energy-system networks and generates district simulation models from Python graphs. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Generated dynamic models depend on Modelica/AixLib and selected demand or network tools. Graph construction alone does not verify hydraulic sizing or model compatibility. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
